{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dellalt Project''' was the name given to the archaeological excavation and study of the ''[[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|Queen of Ranroon]]'', the ancient [[treasure ship]] of the [[Pre-Republic era|pre-Republic]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] ruler [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], which was discovered deep within a system of underground [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot|vaults]] on [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The endeavor was headed by lead researcher [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]], a renowned Xim historian who played a key role in uncovering the lost treasure.<ref name="tec">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>
